title: Smooth route transitions + move Home page Report an Issue trigger to bottom

requirements.summary: Implement smooth, consistent animated transitions on route/page changes across the app, with prefers-reduced-motion support, without touching immutable hook files.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating between routes (e.g., Home -> Browse Rooms -> Room Detail) shows a smooth transition animation rather than an abrupt content swap.
Animations are suppressed or significantly reduced when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
No changes are made to immutable hook files; transitions are implemented in editable layout/routing components and/or global CSS utilities.

file_operations.description: Create a small wrapper component that keys routed content by the current location and applies enter/exit CSS classes for page transitions, while honoring prefers-reduced-motion. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new RouteTransition wrapper into the root layout so the <Outlet /> content transitions on route changes (apply consistently for all routes) without modifying any immutable hook files. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/adjust global route transition utility classes (fade/slide) and include a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) override to disable or significantly reduce animations for accessibility. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Move the existing Home page “Report an Issue” trigger to the bottom of the Home page content (above the global footer) while preserving the same dialog behavior and label text.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the “Report an Issue” button is placed at the bottom of the page content (not in the hero section).
Clicking the button still opens the existing ReportIssueDialog and submitting still works as before.
The button remains visible and properly styled in both light and dark themes without overlapping the site-wide footer.

file_operations.description: Remove the current ReportIssueDialog trigger from the hero section and re-add the same trigger/button near the end of the Home page content (visually above the global footer), keeping the exact English label “Report an Issue” and the existing dialog behavior unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

If needed, add a small utility/style adjustment to ensure the bottom-placed trigger has adequate spacing above the footer and remains readable in both light and dark themes, without redesigning the overall theme. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
